result.summary: Found 1 issue: the Orders tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon. The rest of the page (header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and restaurant cards) renders correctly.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the Orders tab shows only its text label with an empty space above it, while Home, Search and Profile each display an icon above their label. The icon appears to have failed to load or render.
issues.suggestion: Restore the Orders tab icon (e.g. a receipt or bag glyph) by checking the asset reference or icon name, and make sure it renders at the same size and alignment as the other tab icons.
